g.text: Database schema v20 (one file evedm.sqlite3, WAL, on the /app/data volume)
alliance_id : INTEGER (read from ESI; the alliance gate)
posted : 0 pending | 1 posted | 2 not posted (Discord, v11)
event_key : TEXT «PK» (type : structure or system : time)
message_id : TEXT (Discord message, edited for more recipients)
seen_at : REAL (the character's structure search found the gate)
name, owner_id, owner_name, system_id, type_id, type_name
source : EVE Ref | Local index | Adam4EVE (v13)
seen_at : REAL (a character has an asset there; picks the token)
seen_at : REAL (ESI character search: the character may dock there; picks the token first; shown as a count only)
term : TEXT (the system-name prefix or full name that returned it; NULL before v17)
checked_at : REAL (last run; 0 = due at the next scout run)
found : INTEGER (IDs returned by the last run)
capped : INTEGER (terms of this pass still at the cap after the split into full names)
cursor : INTEGER (next term of the character's prefix list)
passes : INTEGER (complete passes; 0 = the first one is still running)
refused_at : REAL (ESI answered 403; not asked again for no_access_refresh_hours)
structure_id : INTEGER «PK» (one find per structure, no FK: the row may exist before known_structures has it)
owner_id : INTEGER (corporation link that followed the structure link; NULL = none)
system_id : INTEGER (from the text before the first " - "; NULL = not recognised)
mail_id : INTEGER (newest mail that named it)
mail_id : INTEGER «PK» (global: a mail sent to several characters is parsed once; no text is kept)
checked_at : REAL (0 = retry at the next run)
last_mail_id : INTEGER (mails up to this ID were seen)
mails : INTEGER (bodies opened by the last run)
found : INTEGER (finds of the last run)
